Order:

(Per Hon'ble Sri Justice P. Naveen Rao) This Writ Petition is filed by the wife of the detenu aggrieved by the detention of the detenu, by name, Sri Mohd. Shahid Pasha S/o. late Mohd. Drug Offenders, Goondas, Immoral Traffic Offenders and Land Grabbers, Spurious Seed Offenders,
Insecticide Offenders, Fertilizer Offenders, Food Adulteration Offenders, Fake Document Offenders,
Scheduled Commodities Offenders, Forest Offenders, Gaming Offenders, Sexual Offenders,
Explosive Substances Offenders, Arms Offenders, Cyber Crime Offenders and White Collar or Financial Offenders Act, 1986, (Act 1 of 1986), vide Ref. (Law and Order) Department, dated 13.09.2021 approved by the 1st respondent as confirmed vide G.O.Rt.No.218, General Administration (SPL. Law and Order)
Department dated 29.01.2022, by the 1st respondent.
2. The order of detention is challenged on the ground that three crimes, referred to, are not grave offences affecting the public at large and do not require invoking extreme measure of preventive detention under the Act 1 of 1986.
3.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned Government Pleader for Home sought to justify the detention order on the ground that while the public servants were discharging their duty, the detenu has attacked the Revenue as well as Police officials and used vulgar language and therefore, the conduct of the detenu warranted severe action, or else he would continue to involve in such kind of activities.
3. The three crimes were looked into to resort to preventively detaining the detenu.

Crime No.116 of 2021 concerns some altercation that took place in a toddy shop; Crime No.118 of 2021 appears to be continuation to Crime No.116 of 2021 and PNR,J & Dr.GRR,J concerns the very same toddy shop.
These two crimes are result of inter-se disputes between the complainant and the detenu and they cannot be shown in aggravated form to hold that they will have an impact on the public at large.
Keeping aside these two crimes, even emphasis by the learned Government Pleader on Crime No.91 of 2021 is misplaced.

No doubt, the instances narrated in the crime are very grave and requires stringent action if they were proved, but, the instances, shown therein, are only isolated instances,
concerning alleged construction of a Masjid in the Government land.
It cannot be said that these things would happen again and again outside that land and will have an impact on the peace and tranquillity in the area and affect public order.
Therefore, we are of the opinion that the order of detention is not sustainable in the facts of this case.
4. Accordingly, the Writ Petition is allowed.

The impugned detention order passed by the Office of the Collector and District Magistrate, Kamareddy - 2nd respondent vide Ref. No.C2/9038/2021-M,
dated 08.11.2021 and the consequential confirmation order of the Principal Secretary, General PNR,J & Dr.GRR,J Administration (Poll) GAD, Secretariat, Hyderabad - 1st respondent, vide G.O.Rt.No.2083 General Administration (Spl. (Law and Order) Department, dated 13.09.2021 and approved by the 1st respondent as confirmed vide G.O.Rt.No.218, General Administration (SPL.
Law and Order) Department, dated 29.01.2022, are hereby set aside.

The respondents are directed to set the detenu, namely Mohd. Shahid Pasha S/o. late Mohd. Chand Pasha, aged about 38 years,
Occ: Business, R/o. H.No.5-22, Gopalpet village of Nagireddypet Mandal of Kamareddy District, at liberty forthwith, if he is no longer required in any other criminal case.
